note: Routes that are events, read through lore.land's ?/ door (book/scripts/modules/route-events.mjs, painted by /texture/). An event is one entry: a surface named like a subdomain, what kind it is, when it opens and closes (the reader's local calendar day), what it says before, during and after, and where it lands. A new promotional route is a new entry here; nothing else changes. Standing events are always open; a release takes its date from the serial.

events.title: A day in the land
events.says: A reading for each day, chosen from the chapters as they stand: a room for the day, a trope for the week, a lens for the month. Name a day to read it: *2026-11-13.

events.title: The next stone
events.says: When the next chapter is set, and where it is once it has come.
